findings.hypothesis: Path traversal via file operations in CLI or validators

findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Path traversal in CLI
 * @description File operations in CLI with untrusted paths can lead to unauthorized file access
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity error
 * @id py/cli-path-injection
 * @tags security
 *        external/cwe/cwe-022
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call, string filename
where
  (
    call = API::moduleImport("pathlib").getMember("Path").getACall() or
    call = API::builtin("open").getACall() or
    call = API::moduleImport("json").getMember("load").getACall()
  ) and
  call.getLocation().getFile().getBaseName() = "cli.py" and
  filename = call.getLocation().getFile().getRelativePath()
select call, "File operation in CLI module at " + filename + " may be vulnerable to path traversal if user-controlled."
findings.hypothesis: Path traversal in jsonschema CLI module where file arguments are processed

message.text: File operation in CLI module at jsonschema/cli.py may be vulnerable to path traversal if user-controlled.

findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Uncontrolled recursion in schema validation
 * @description Recursive function calls without depth limits can lead to stack overflow DoS
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity warning
 * @id py/uncontrolled-recursion
 * @tags security
 *        external/cwe/cwe-674
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call, Function func
where
  // Look for recursive calls in validation-related functions
  call.getFunction().getALocalSource().asExpr().(Name).getId() = func.getName() and
  call.getLocation().getFile() = func.getLocation().getFile() and
  (
    func.getName().matches("%validate%") or
    func.getName().matches("%check%") or
    func.getName().matches("%resolve%") or
    func.getName().matches("%iter%")
  ) and
  // In jsonschema package files
  func.getLocation().getFile().getRelativePath().matches("jsonschema/%")
select call, "Recursive call to " + func.getName() + " may be vulnerable to stack overflow DoS without depth limits."
findings.hypothesis: Recursive validation functions without depth limits could cause stack overflow DoS

message.text: Recursive call to _validate_instance may be vulnerable to stack overflow DoS without depth limits.
Recursive call to validates may be vulnerable to stack overflow DoS without depth limits.
